sentences.en: Passengers for Cambridge, please make your way to platform No.6.
sentences.zh: 去剑桥站的乘客请前往6号月台。

sentences.en: My dream is to study computer science at Cambridge University.
sentences.zh: 我的梦想是在剑桥大学学习计算机科学。

sentences.en: Cambridge is the most famous university in the world.
sentences.zh: 剑桥是世界上最著名的大学之一。
